svg.title: RL-Kernel: from RL orchestration to hardware backends
svg.desc: vime coordinates vLLM rollout and Megatron-LM training. Both engines connect through custom operator hooks to RL-Kernel, which provides deterministic and optimized logprob, attention, GEMM, sampling, RL loss, and normalization operators. The target families shown are CUDA SM90 on H100, H200 and GH200; ROCm gfx942 on MI300A, MI300X and MI325X; and partially adapted Ascend dav_c220. This is an architectural overview. Backend availability depends on the selected operator.
